# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

Load in results from Extinct and Extant simulations:

```{r load-results}
thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/A/Extinct/thresholds.rds")
error_rates <- readRDS("Outputs/A/Extant/error_rates.rds")
```

Specify "ideal" values for thresholds and error rates:
```{r ideal-values}
ideal_threshold <- c(100, 125)
ideal_errorrate <- c(0, 0.1)
```


# Comparison

```{r comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
scenario_a <- left_join(thresholds, error_rates, by = "model")

comparison_plot <- ggplot(scenario_a) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = ideal_threshold[1], xmax = ideal_threshold[2], 
                ymin = ideal_errorrate[1], ymax = ideal_errorrate[2]),
            fill = "palegreen", colour = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(x = threshold, y = error_rate)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(100, 250)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Required Test Time to Achieve > 80% Power (Extinct)"),
    y = "Estimated Type I Error Rate (Extant)"
  ) 

comparison_plot

best_models <- scenario_a %>% 
    filter(threshold < 125, error_rate < 0.1) %>% 
    pull(model)

best_models <- paste0("- ", best_models, collapse = "\n")

header <- paste0(
  "Models with power threshold < ", ideal_threshold[2],
  " and Type I error rate < ", ideal_errorrate[2], ":"
)

asis_output(paste0(header, "\n\n```text\n", best_models, "\n```"))
```
